hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && git ls-files -co --exclude-standard -z | xargs -0 grep -nIE '/(Users|home)/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+/' 2>/dev/null | head -5 | grep . >&2 && { echo 'Absolute home path in the repo: use a repo-relative or ~/ path instead.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0

cat | grep -q '"stop_hook_active": *true' && exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && cargo clippy -q --all-targets -- -D warnings 1>&2 && cargo test -q 1>&2 || { echo 'Quality gate failed: fix the clippy / test errors above before finishing.' >&2; exit 2; }

cat | grep -q '"stop_hook_active": *true' && exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && git diff --quiet HEAD -- src tests Cargo.toml 2>/dev/null && exit 0; cargo clippy -q --all-targets -- -D warnings 1>&2 && cargo test -q 1>&2 || { echo 'Quality gate failed: fix the clippy / test errors above before finishing.' >&2; exit 2; }
